decision_conditions: No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site, or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.
The period of this consent shall be five years from the date of this consent, following which the advertisement shall be removed and the site reinstated.
Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the local planning authority.
The maximum luminance of the sign shall not exceed the values recommended in the Institution of Lighting Engineers' Technical Report No. 5 (Third Edition).
All illumination shall be non-intermittent unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.
Where an advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the local planning authority.

No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any road traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air, or so as otherwise to render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway or aerodrome (civil or military).
Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
description: Advertisement Consent: Installation of one externally illuminated fascia sign and one non-illuminated cut out stainless steel logo and lettering sign to mesh fence
